records.title: Production XRP signal generation code audit at main 34722b7
records.note: emit_signal.py classifies a text string with GitHub Models then Groq fallback; if both fail it returns score 0 and confidence 0. It optionally blends that score equally with a relevance-weighted sentiment score from distilled news. It uses recent XRP-relevant headlines or a default 'market sideways; low conviction' string. It does not ingest order-book, on-chain, derivatives, ETF, stablecoin, collateral or macro features; does not call core/hrm_ternary.py; and does not define a price target or forecast horizon. It fetches CoinGecko XRP price after scoring only to record price_at_emission in signal_history.jsonl.

records.title: Main-branch signal history and accuracy artifact audit
records.note: At the inspected main commit, web/signal_history.jsonl is an empty file while web/signal_accuracy.json claims 1,683 checked and 772 correct (45.9%). The current repository state therefore cannot reproduce that summary from its designated history input. The latest signal explicitly reports GitHub Models credential absence and Groq HTTP 429; score 44 is consistent with the code's equal blend of fallback score 0 and news_score 88, with confidence 0. This is a sentiment/fallback artifact, not a calibrated directional forecast. The historical summary may have been generated from records no longer present; do not call it fabricated.

records.title: HRM ternary resolver implementation audit
records.note: The module explicitly says it has no trained weights and is not a neural network. It uses deterministic seeded random matrices and a nested H/L convergence heuristic. HRMResolution.confidence is computed as agreement multiplied by convergence, not calibrated predictive probability. The function accepts a caller-supplied signals dictionary; it does not ingest market data itself. The inspected production scripts/emit_signal.py does not import or invoke this module.

records.title: Manual Knowledge Signal Cycle workflow audit
records.note: The active workflow is workflow_dispatch-only, not scheduled. It grants contents:write, runs news ingestion, distillation and emit_signal.py, then commits and pushes knowledge log/config, latest_signal.json and signal_history.jsonl directly to main. This is a separate manual main-write path not changed by PR #1379, which addresses the scheduled cross-analysis and daily accuracy writers.

records.title: Historical HRM signal ledger audit
records.note: The separate data/signal_ledger.jsonl contains 45 XRP/USD records from July 4-7, 2026; all 45 labels/states are NULL, maximum confidence is 0.317, and multiple records show degraded sentiment ('choices' parsing error or no GROQ_API_KEY). The records contain emission-time source fields but no fixed-horizon realized outcomes. They are diagnostic history, not a supervised forecast/backtest dataset.

records.title: CoinDesk: crypto liquidations jump after Binance incident and technology-stock weakness
records.author: Oliver Knight and Omkar Godbole
records.note: CoinDesk reports BTC around USD77,350 and ETH around USD2,220, crypto futures liquidations USD1.57B, aggregate OI down 3% to USD136.3B, futures volume up 74% to USD346.1B, and Nasdaq-100 futures down 2.3% after Amazon capex guidance and Intel weakness. This is broad risk-off context with both crypto-specific and technology-equity shocks; it does not isolate the Binance incident's causal contribution to XRP.

records.title: The Block: XRP and major crypto assets fall during Binance incident
records.author: Timmy Shen
records.note: The Block reports XRP down approximately 7% over 24 hours at its 22:00 ET Thursday snapshot, alongside BTC -4.5%, ETH -5.2% and BNB -7.1%. Secondary venue/price snapshot; this is an event-window observation, not a causal estimate or current price.
